meta.title: Development planning & delivery Mode
meta.description: An expensive main model that only plans, dispatches and reviews: recon/review gather facts, scribe writes documents, and develop implements and reports back directly. standard is the default with no extra dependency; the development setup can also be chosen from presets installed on the host (such as deep-ptc), and the provider/model come from the host catalog. The model guard governs only this session's subagents by default and never the main session.
